about: Hostile edge cases for tests/adversarial-astronomy.spec.ts. Written by tests/fixtures/build-adversarial-cases.py; do not edit by hand. All birth data is synthetic.

timeZoneReference.source: The host's compiled IANA tz database (zic, with backzone), read with CPython zoneinfo; each expected offset was also typed by hand from the zone's published history, and the generator stops if the two differ.
